text.description_html:
TC612 Full Cover Grade 1 Tri Packed Door Closer

The Global TC612 Door Closer are our most economically priced full cover Grade 1 door closer. They are recommended for use on commercial, architectural and institutional applications. Ideal for business, new construction and renovations. Available in Dark Bronze or Aluminum finish.

Also available: Grade 1 Polished Brass Door Closer and ADA Compliant Grade 1 Door Closer

Global TC612 Door Closers are non-handed and have individual adjustments for sweep speed, latch speed, and backcheck cushioning. They are tri packed for regular, top jamb or parallel arm installations. They fit 11-3/32" x 3/4" mounting hole pattern and packaged complete with wood and machine screws.

Features and Specifications for Global TC612 Commercial Grade 1 Door Closers

  • Adjustable closing speed
  • Adjustable latching speed
  • Adjustable back check
  • Aluminum Alloy Shell
  • Horizontal Mounting Holes: 11-3/32"
  • Vertical Mounting Holes: 3/4"
  • Maximum Door Size: 60" interior / 48" exterior
  • Maximum Door Weight: 258 lbs
  • Spring Tension: Adjustable 2 - 6
  • Tri packed for regular, top jamb or parallel arm mounting
  • Non Handed
  • Optional Hold Open
  • UL 10C Approved (UL R7483 615R)
  • Includes Full Cover
  • Grade 1 Certified
  • 15 Year Manufacture Warranty
  • TC600 Series Instructions

This closer can be ordered with the Standard Arm or Optional Hold Open Arm.
Also available other TC600 Series Closer Accessories
